evals.name: rust-e0502-explained
evals.prompt: cargo build fails with error[E0502]: cannot borrow `scores` as mutable because it is also borrowed as immutable. I don't get it, what is it telling me?
evals.expected_output: Loads tutor-rust-expert (or its ownership reference), explains shared vs mutable borrows at once, points at the line, does not write the fix.

idioms.text: explains that a shared (immutable) borrow is still alive while a mutable one is taken

evals.name: typescript-enum-in-node
evals.prompt: When I run `node main.ts` I get a SyntaxError on my enum. Node is supposed to run TypeScript now, so what's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Explains that node only strips erasable syntax and enum is not erasable; suggests a const object plus a union type without writing the learner's code.

idioms.text: explains that node strips types and enum is not erasable syntax
